svg.text: Same Sentinel-2 band (B04, 10980×10980) — stored as a COG vs a GeoZarr
byte layout of the file (not to scale)
header holds the byte offset of every block
first 32 KB — 1 GET gives the whole layout
GeoZarr — one store, all bands × all resolutions
one array per band in every group
r10m/b04/c/0/0 — ONE shard = the whole array
Pyramid, to scale — grid lines = smallest unit a reader can fetch
